summary: U.S. Central Command has instructed the IDF to prepare for a possible renewed military campaign in Iran, backed by a massive regional force buildup including approximately 200 tanker aircraft and three aircraft carriers. Simultaneously, Israeli forces struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, eliminating Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and five others, while Iranian air defense systems registered heightened activity across six provinces. Houthi forces claimed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure as Riyadh presses the EU for a terrorist designation.
key_points: U.S. warns IDF and Gulf states to prepare for renewed Iran campaign amid deployment of ~200 tankers and three carriers. (Source: @yediotnews25/137762)
IDF kills Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail in Nasser Hospital strike, six dead, 20+ wounded. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)

Iranian air defenses active in Khuzestan, Kurdistan, West Azerbaijan, Hormozgan; missile launch, UAV ops, AA fire reported. (Source: @shin_persian/12295, @shin_persian/12290, @shin_persian/12297, @shin_persian/12296, @shin_persian/12292, @shin_persian/12293)
Houthis claim strikes on Saudi East-West pipeline pumping station and Yanbu oil facility; Saudi unconfirmed. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9899)
Saudi Arabia urges EU to designate Houthis terrorist group; lacks unanimous support among 27 members. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9896)
Israeli strike near Shifa Hospital kills one, injures several; Palestinian media reports vehicle targeted. (Source: @manniefabian/59509)
Iraqi Jurf al-Sakhar operation paused for political deal to allow government forces entry. (Source: @shin_persian/12307)

Lebanese border shelling continues at Wadi al-Hujeir, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Wadi al-Salouqi, Mais al-Jabal, Aitaroun. (Source: @redlinkleb/52896, @redlinkleb/52909, @redlinkleb/52942, @redlinkleb/52940)

sections.executive_summary: U.S. Central Command has instructed the IDF to prepare for a possible renewed military campaign in Iran, backed by a massive regional force buildup including approximately 200 tanker aircraft and three aircraft carriers. Simultaneously, Israeli forces struck the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis, eliminating Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and five others, while Iranian air defense systems registered heightened activity across six provinces. Houthi forces claimed attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure as Riyadh presses the EU for a terrorist designation.

points: Iranian air defense systems engaged in Izeh, Khuzestan Province at 22:40 local time (1910Z), indicating heightened alert status in the southwestern region. (Source: @shin_persian/12295)
Military jet activity observed over Marivan in Kurdistan Province, suggesting possible patrol or response operations near the western border. (Source: @shin_persian/12290)
A missile was launched from Haftkel, Khuzestan Province at 2007Z (23:37 Tehran time), origin and target unspecified but recorded by monitoring networks. (Source: @shin_persian/12297)
UAV launch from Omidiyeh accompanied by heavy anti-aircraft activity in Khuzestan Province, pointing to integrated drone and air defense operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12296)
UAV activity detected over Urmia, West Azerbaijan Province at 22:31 local (1901Z), marking continued unmanned aerial operations in the northwest. (Source: @shin_persian/12292)
An explosion occurred near Sarkhur Tahruyi, Sirik in Hormozgan Province on the southern coast, cause unconfirmed but noted by incident trackers. (Source: @shin_persian/12293)

Video footage emerged showing an Iranian ballistic missile launcher exploding due to an air strike or failure during the 39-day war, while a second launcher nearby successfully fired a missile. (Source: @shin_persian/12299)

IDF and Shin Bet confirmed an overnight strike on the Nasser Hospital complex in Khan Younis targeting Muhammad Abu Ismail, commander of Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade, killing six and wounding at least 20 according to Hamas authorities. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)

The military stated the second floor of Nasser Hospital served as a Hamas military headquarters and the strike targeted the room where militants operated after repeated warnings to cease military activity in the compound. (Source: @yediotnews25/137760)

Palestinian media reported one dead and several injured in an Israeli strike on a vehicle just outside Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, indicating continued targeting of Hamas infrastructure in northern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/59509)

U.S. Central Command notified IDF representatives in recent days to prepare for a possible renewed campaign in Iran, accompanied by a regional force buildup of approximately 200 tanker aircraft, two aircraft carriers, and a third carrier expected next week. (Source: @yediotnews25/137762)

Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot received a security and diplomatic briefing from Prime Minister Netanyahu and military secretary Maj. Gen. Guy Markizeno at the Prime Minister's Office, covering current security challenges. (Source: @manniefabian/59508)
Netanyahu and Eisenkot agreed to continue mutual updates as required, signaling coordination between caretaker government and opposition on security matters. (Source: @amitsegal/67176)

The IDF strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis targeted senior Hamas commander Muhammad Abu Ismail and additional terrorists hiding in the facility, resulting in six fatalities and at least 20 wounded per Hamas health authorities. (Source: @manniefabian/59505)
Israeli forces struck a vehicle near Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, killing one person and injuring several others, according to Palestinian media reports. (Source: @manniefabian/59509)

IDF spokesperson stated the Nasser Hospital's second floor functioned as a Hamas military command center and the attack focused on the specific room used by militants after prior warnings to halt military use of the hospital. (Source: @yediotnews25/137760)

Hamas authorities confirmed casualties from the Nasser Hospital strike but did not disclose identities beyond the brigade commander; the military results remain under review by IDF and Shin Bet. (Source: @manniefabian/59507)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Hujeir sector, with live mapping indicating ongoing bombardment in the area. (Source: @redlinkleb/52896)
An explosion occurred in Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, marked on live maps, suggesting a strike or detonation in the eastern sector. (Source: @redlinkleb/52909)
Artillery shelling recorded in Wadi al-Salouqi, continuing the pattern of fire along the southern Lebanese border region. (Source: @redlinkleb/52942)
Artillery shelling targeted Mais al-Jabal and Aitaroun, two adjacent villages in the border area, per live mapping data. (Source: @redlinkleb/52940)

Iraqi paramilitary leader Al-Zaidi reportedly paused the Jurf al-Sakhar operation temporarily to allow Framework political leaders to negotiate a deal with factions, aiming to enable Defense and Interior Ministry forces
